title: Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2605.20922v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Oscillations and synchronization are widely believed to play a fundamental role in representation and computation. However, existing machine learning approaches based on synchronization dynamics have largely been confined to specialized settings such as object discovery, with limited evidence of scalability to standard vision benchmarks or logic reasoning tasks. We propose the Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN), a dynamical neural architecture based on generalized Winfree dynamics. WONN evolves representations on the torus $(S^1)^d$ through structured oscillatory interactions, combining phase-based inductive biases with flexible and hierarchical interaction mechanisms instantiated as either fixed trigonometric mappings or learnable neural networks. translated_abstract: 振荡与同步被广泛认为在表示与计算中扮演着基础性角色。然而，现有基于同步动力学的机器学习方法大多局限于物体发现等专门化场景，其在标准视觉基准或逻辑推理任务上可扩展性的证据十分有限。我们提出了 Winfree 振荡神经网络（WONN），这是一种基于广义 Winfree 动力学的动态神经架构。WONN 通过结构化的振荡交互在环面 $(S^1)^d$ 上演化表示，将基于相位的归纳偏置与灵活且分层的交互机制相结合，这些交互机制既可以实例化为固定的三角映射，也可以实例化为可学习的神经网络。我们在图像识别与复杂推理任务上对 WONN 进行了评估，包括 CIFAR、ImageNet、Maze-hard 和 Sudoku。在上述各个领域中，WONN 都取得了具有竞争力乃至更优的性能表现。
tldr: 提出基于广义 Winfree 动力学的振荡神经网络 WONN，通过环面上的结构化相位振荡交互，将同步动力学方法成功扩展到 CIFAR、ImageNet、Maze-hard、Sudoku 等标准视觉与推理基准，并取得具有竞争力或更优的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN), a dynamical architecture based on generalized Winfree dynamics that evolves phase-based representations on a torus through structured oscillatory interactions, achieving competitive or superior performance on standard vision and reasoning benchmarks such as CIFAR, ImageNet, Maze-hard, and Sudoku.
